```yaml
name: Deploy Website and Spec

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'website/**'
      - 'docs/spec/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-website.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Install mdbook
        run: |
          MDBOOK_VERSION=0.4.38
          curl -L https://github.com/rust-lang/mdbook/releases/download/v$MDBOOK_VERSION/mdbook-v$MDBOOK_VERSION-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | tar -xz
          mv mdbook-v$MDBOOK_VERSION-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/mdbook ./mdbook
          chmod +x ./mdbook
        shell: bash

      - name: Build mdbook-spec preprocessor
        run: |
          cargo build --release -p mdbook-spec
          echo "$(pwd)/target/release" >> $GITHUB_PATH
        shell: bash

      - name: Build website
        run: |
          ./mdbook build website
        shell: bash

      - name: Build spec
        run: |
          ./mdbook build docs/spec
        shell: bash

      - name: Prepare public directory
        run: |
          mkdir -p public/website public/spec
          cp -r website/book/* public/website/
          cp -r docs/spec/book/* public/spec/
        shell: bash

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4
        with:
          branch: gh-pages
          folder: public
          clean: true
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```

      - name: Install mdbook
        run: |

          mv mdbook-v$MDBOOK_VERSION-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/mdbook ./mdbook

        shell: bash

        shell: bash

        shell: bash

      - name: Build spec
